name: deepsea-matador-meeting.pdf
description: March 19, 1975 White House Cabinet Room memorandum of conversation (SECRET/NODIS, declassified) in which President Ford, Schlesinger, Colby, Buchen, Marsh, Rumsfeld, and Scowcroft discuss the successful "Matador" operation, whether to confirm it publicly, and Soviet reaction, with the accompanying archival folder record for Box 10 of the NSA Memoranda of Conversations collection.
